telecoms_legend:
How to use this Document
The Telephony coverage guide helps customers understand the features and capabilities of Amazon Connect Customer
Definitions:
Country:- Many countries have local "Know Your Customer" telecoms regulations requiring Connect Customer to collect documentation from our customers,
before we can assign a phone number. Please click the link to determine what documentation is required for the country. Note, these requirements may
include your company having a physical presence in the country, business registration documents, and/or proof of ID.
Service Type:- Whether the country supports Inbound numbers (DID), Inbound Toll-free numbers (Toll-free), Universal International Freephone Number
(UIFN) or whether only Outbound calls are supported for this country. (Yellow ticks indicate use case criteria checks)
Number Availability:- Confirms number types available for the country. DID (National, Geo, or in some countries Mobile) or Toll-free (ITFN). Connect
Customer does not provide Shared cost or Premium rate numbers.
National Outbound:- Describes whether Connect Customer provides outbound calling within the country using a local Caller ID (CLID). For example, calling
from a US number to a US number (+1-455-555-1212 to +1-800-555-1212). Green tick indicates Connect telephony providers guarantee delivery of
outbound calls with properly displayed CLID at the destination, yellow tick indicates support for use in outbound but not guarentee CLI will be delivered to
end users
International Outbound:- Describes whether Connect Customer provides calling to another country using the number as CLID. For example, calling from a
US number to a UK number (+1-455-555-1212 to +4477711223344). If checked, international outbound provides best effort to present the CLID of the
number claimed in Amazon Connect number to the destination recipient.
Porting Available:- Indicates that we are able to port numbers for this country. By default this is limited to DIDs (Geographic, National and in a small
number of countries Mobile numbers) and TollFree numbers. Premium Rate, Shared cost and special services are not supported by Amazon Connect
Customer (Yellow Ticks indicate support is limited to certain numbers).
Multi Carrier:- Connect Customer offers multi carrier configurations as default in most countries. The green check indicates where it is possible to claim
multiple DIDs or TollFree Numbers from different carriers. The * on US Toll Free indicates the presence of the US RespOrg configuration, where multi carrier
is default. For Outbound countries a green check indicates that Connect routes outbound via multiple carriers for resilience.
Custom CallerID:- Connect Customer allows you to provide us with proof of ownership of a number not listed on Amazon Connect Customer, and present
this as your outbound caller ID.
Status:- Confirms whether the country is General Availability (GA), in Early Access or BETA where we customers can request early access (Production
Traffic is not recommended) or Test (testing only), or Restricted (where additional validation of the use case is required).
Region:- The AWS Region(s) where a country's phone numbers can be claimed or managed in the Amazon Connect Customer console.
Pricing:- Amazon Connect Customer provides pay as you go blended pricing to provide you the easiest access to global telecoms
Call Quality:- Customers should be aware that they must folllow best practise when setting up routing outside of the home region

region_selection.quote: Region selection is contingent upon data governance requirements, use case, services available in each Region, telephony costs in each Region, and latency in relation to your agents, contacts, and external transfer endpoint geography.

agent_isolation.quote: Isolation is required for agents in India, South Korea, and South Africa.

single_instance_default.quote: pair) in the absence of compelling requirements requiring multiple Regions.

latency_anchor.quote: Anchor either your phone numbers or agents in the same AWS Region where they are geographically located.

latency_500.quote: If both your phone numbers and agents are located in an AWS Region that is different from the one where your Connect Customer instance is created, call latency is extended above 500ms for network latency (WebRTC RTT).

latency_900.quote: When call latency is greater than 900ms for both network and telephony latency, it leads to a significant delay between agents and customers.

latency_test.quote: Use the Connect Customer Endpoint Test Utility to check latency.

cross_region_numbers.quote: As of July 2023 we have simplified requirements to claim phone numbers that are located in countries outside of the AWS Region where your Connect Customer instance is located.

porting_lead_time.quote: Open a porting request as far in advance of your pending go-live date as possible.

lang_ai_regions.quote: Not available in instances in the Africa (Cape Town) AWS Region and AWS GovCloud (US-West).

lang_auto_eval_regions.quote: Automated performance evaluations filled using generative AI is not available in instances in the following AWS Regions: Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), Asia Pacific (Seoul) and AWS GovCloud (US-West).

outbound_default_deny.quote: Connect Customer country allowlisting supports a default deny model; unless you have specifically been allowed to call countries you will be blocked when attempting to call.
